protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: at the advisory-tested nef commit 5ce35eab62b49b46c02be55d0c8ab23ce0300bee, NewServer mounts getOamRoutes on NefOamResUriPrefix without middleware; GET / dispatches to GetOamIndex, which unconditionally returns HTTP 200 with null. The vendor issue records no-token runtime requests reaching this path while OAuth2 was enabled, and CVE-2026-44327 remains PUBLISHED while GHSA-cmpj-2x3g-m7g3 has withdrawn_at=null.

The earlier 3ae828b1315fde7e0d9da74ae25b23816aad4a08 created only an empty OAM group and no reachable handler.
